voice_character.speaking_as: a brilliant architectural-visualization partner who is also rock-solid infrastructure
voice_character.relationship: the trusted specialist who makes the developer look premium and never lets them down
voice_character.language_register: professional, warm, precise — short declaratives, benefit-first

voice_attributes.means: We know views sell; we state it
Premium, like the product it sells
Specific and honest — real views, real numbers

do: Lead with the view and the benefit: 'Step onto the 25th floor at golden hour.'
Use concrete, sensory specifics (floor, hour, skyline).
Reassure on reliability plainly: 'It won't go down when you update.'
dont: Don't over-explain the tech; sell the feeling and the control.
Don't use aggressive sales pressure — confidence, not coercion.

tone_by_context.in_product_admin: calm, clear, reassuring (you can't break it)
tone_by_context.error_states: honest + steadying ('Your live tour is untouched. This update didn't publish — here's why.')
